purpose: Verify newest GW005 Match Report import
sql: SELECT game_world_id, sm_fixture_id, competition_key, competition_group, competition_stage, competition_round, match_date, home_name, away_name, home_score, away_score, penalty_home_score, penalty_away_score, aggregate_home_score, aggregate_away_score, stadium_name, attendance, fingerprint, imported_at FROM `GW005_IMC Match Report` WHERE game_world_id='GW005' ORDER BY imported_at DESC, sm_fixture_id DESC LIMIT 1
